name: Georgian Bay Islands National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed, on a leash of at most 3 m.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed, on a leash of at most 3 m.

excerpts.quote: All domestic animals must be kept under direct physical control (i.e. on a leash (max 3 meters) or in suitable confinement).

dogRules.text: Leash of at most 3 m, or suitable confinement.
Pets must not be left unattended on campsites.
A leash helps protect dogs from rattlesnakes, porcupines and poison ivy.
Pets must stay leashed at primitive campsites.
